topic: Map Lamp Service SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) for Reading Lamp Control
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific control command or function related to reading lamps in a vehicle, including individual lamp control and global control.

column_semantics.left: Function Description (e.g., 'Open/Close Rear Left Reading Lamp')
column_semantics.middle: SOA Command Details (Service Call with Lamp ID and ON/OFF State)

core_entities.name: MapLampService
core_entities.description: The service responsible for managing map and reading lamps in the vehicle.

core_conditions.name: LampID
core_conditions.description: Identifier for the specific lamp being controlled (e.g., RL - Rear Left, RR - Rear Right, FL - Front Left, FR - Front Right).

core_conditions.name: LampOnOff
core_conditions.description: State of the lamp, either ON or OFF.

core_outputs.name: MapLampOnOff.MapLampOnOffSts
core_outputs.description: Status update indicating the current on/off state of the specified lamp(s).

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the API calls required to control individual and all reading lamps in a vehicle, providing a clear mapping between human-readable commands and their corresponding service-oriented architecture (SOA) calls. It is used for testing the functionality of the MapLampService in responding to requests to turn reading lamps on or off.
